content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Migration 20: reporter_stats. polaris-backend/src/reputation/{mod,score}.rs with pure reputation(stats, now) -> ReputationScore (Bayesian smoothing, operator-config prior). Action insert hook increments stats per kind. ReputationScore newtype clamped [0,1]. Pattern engine integration via Box<dyn ReputationProvider>. Case view DTO carries reporter context. Property tests: brand-new=prior, established-good>0.95, established-bad<0.05. Subsumes #74 (which I filed for the T3 wiring).
